senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (लोडति)
To agitate, to stir, to churn.
r. 1st and 6th cls. (लोडति लुडति)
1 To be in connexion or contact with any thing, to join, to adhere to, to rest in or on, &c.
2 To embrace.
r. 6th cl. (-लुडति)
To cover, to conceal.
(इ) लुडि r. 10th cl. (लुण्ठयति)
1 To be agitated.
2 To plunder.
